transcript.text: Hola, ¡qué alegría verte! Soy Sparky, tu amigo dragón. Hoy mi nave espacial brilla con muchos colores. ¿Cuál es tu color favorito?
¡Mira mira! Mi color favorito es blue. ¿blue?
Oh, blue is a beautiful color, just like the deep space! My favorite color is bright orange, like my dragon scales. What other colors do you see on my ship today?
Wow, you found the red one! That is a super bright red, just like a star. Do you see any yellow on my ship too?
Yes! You found it! That is a shiny yellow button. You are so good at finding colors!
Exactly! You found the shiny yellow button! It has been so much fun finding colors with you today, you did a great job. Next time, tell me all about your favorite toys. See you later!
